items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Well, we had Edmund Hall, Fernando Arbello, Skippy Boland, Arnold Boland, Cyril Haynes, and forgot the guitarist's name.

ctx.x: that band. I have known the name, such a catchy, right, Billy Hicks and his Sizzling Six, but tell me something about that band.
Well, we had Edmund Hall, Fernando Arbello, Skippy Boland, Arnold Boland, Cyril Haynes, and forgot the guitarist's name. I'll get that. But we had the jumping band.
